description:
Record it, and know who said what.

Transcription Studio turns a recording, a file or a video into a transcript that is split by speaker — and the models that do it run on your iPhone and iPad.

ON YOUR DEVICE
Speech recognition and speaker separation happen here. No audio is sent to a transcription service, because there is no such service in the pipeline. The speech model downloads once, about 1.6 GB, and after that a transcript costs nothing but battery — in airplane mode, out of signal, anywhere.

WHO SAID WHAT
Speakers are separated automatically and stay straight for the length of the session, so a two-hour interview reads as a conversation instead of a wall of text. Name a speaker from your contacts once and the name follows them through the transcript.

ANYTHING WITH AUDIO IN IT
Record live and watch the words arrive. Choose a file, pull a video out of Photos, or send audio in from the share sheet. Paste a link and the Mac app, signed into the same account, transcribes it and sends the transcript back.

WHAT YOU GET BACK
• A transcript you can search, edit and export as text, Markdown, SRT, VTT or Word
• Decisions and action items pulled out of the conversation for you to confirm
• A calendar event or a reminder written from what was said, after you review it
• A question answered out of everything you have ever recorded
• Any session locked behind Face ID
• A transcript read back to you in a voice synthesized on the device
• Siri and Shortcuts for the whole surface: record, transcribe, search, summarize, export

EVERY DEVICE YOU OWN
iPhone, iPad and a real Mac app. Transcription Studio requires a free FCT account: your sessions, transcripts and recordings live in that account, so a new device rebuilds the whole library — every word of every transcript — without downloading a single recording.

PRIVACY
Where the work happens and where the result is kept are two different claims, and they stay separate here. The models run on your device. The library is stored in your FCT account, scoped to you and readable by no other account. No ads, no third-party analytics or tracking SDKs, no advertising identifier; anonymous diagnostics key on a random install identifier joined to no account. Delete a session, this app's data or the whole account from Settings.

Summaries, highlights and library questions use Apple Intelligence and need a device that supports it; a transcript past the on-device window uses Apple's Private Cloud Compute.

Available in ten languages. Requires iOS 27.
promotionalText: Every model runs on your device: the words, the speakers, and the voice that reads them back. Your library lives in your own FCT account — never ours to read.
